evidence_basis: Pathogenic through several-fold lower Ca2+ affinity at the EF-hand III Ca2+-chelating aspartate; the modeled fold and CaV1.2 IQ interface carry no committed expectation. Site pLDDT 69.45 in the complex model and 97.16 in the isolated-subunit model.
EF-hand III; the mutant protein has compromised Ca2+ binding (reported as p.Asn97Ser); no committed expectation on the modeled axes.
C-lobe residue; lowers Ca2+ affinity and alters the coupling of Ca2+ binding to the activating conformational change; no committed expectation on the modeled axes.
Myhre syndrome; impaired SMAD4 monoubiquitination at the adjacent Lys519, a post-translational mechanism outside the modeled axes; no committed expectation on the modeled axes.
